title: Reminders: when iOS notification permission was already decided, tapping the switch shows no alert; the switch stays off and tappable with nothing said
evidence: Seen in checkpoint 1 testing; cause not traced. ios/HealthRoadmap/Reminders/RemindersSection.swift:17-22 the switch calls ask(); :53-56 sets refused only when permission reads denied after ReminderScheduler.optIn (ReminderScheduler.swift:84-89, which asks iOS again; iOS answers at once without a sheet once decided). :23-28 shows the Settings row only while optedIn, which a refusal never sets. A fix needs words for the already-decided case, so it needs the owner
